name: Crater Lake National Park
tagline: Crater Lake — rim overlooks of the deep blue caldera; rim drive seasonal.

practical.transit_note: Long mountain access roads; snow into summer some years.
practical.energy_note: Altitude and cold wind on rim.
practical.best_start: Rim Village visitor area → two overlooks
practical.season_note: Rim Drive often closed late fall–early summer.
